items.guidance: This is a Rails app, so look for a Procfile (for example Procfile or Procfile.dev) and use only its production web entry, typically a Puma or rails server command bound to 0.0.0.0 and the PORT variable. The declared Sidekiq commands are workers and should not become the web CMD. Ignore package.json scripts and any Vite or webpack dev server, because pnpm is only used for asset builds.

The pg gem indicates Rails ActiveRecord migrations under db/migrate, so a package.json script is not needed. Check the Procfile or entrypoint scripts for a release step, such as a release line or a db:chatwoot_prepare-style rake task, and report it if one exists. Otherwise report bundle exec rails db:migrate (or db:prepare) as the non-interactive migration command, run with RAILS_ENV=production.
